login.title: Sign in
login.lede: One shelf, shared between Sllr and the supplier.
login.footnote: Accounts are created in Supabase, not here.
login.noProfile: That account has no profile yet. Ask an admin to set it up, then sign in again.
login.bothFields: Enter both an email address and a password.
login.wrong: That email and password do not match. Try again.

dashboard.title:
Warehouse
management
dashboard.lede: Shared shelf between Sllr and the supplier. Reserve, approve, and watch the free stock move in one place.
dashboard.requestsWaiting: {count, plural, one {# request waiting} other {# requests waiting}}

shelf.searchPlaceholder: Search by name, SKU, or warehouse code

catalog.title: Catalog
catalog.lede: The supplier’s whole shelf. Reserving asks for stock — nothing is deducted until the supplier approves.
catalog.emptyShelf: The shelf is empty. Products show up here once the supplier lists them.
catalog.noMatch: Nothing matches that. Try a different SKU or clear the filter.

reserve.title: Reserve {product}
reserve.notPriced: This product is not priced yet, so this request carries no value.
reserve.worth: {cost} per unit → this request is worth {value}
reserve.sent: Request sent — waiting on supplier approval

inventory.title: Inventory
inventory.lede: Your shelf. Reserved is what Sllr has been granted — it is worked out from approved requests, never typed in.
inventory.empty: Nothing on the shelf yet. Add a product to start.
inventory.noMatch: Nothing matches that. Try a different SKU or clear the filter.
inventory.codeHint: Line, rack, bin — for example L03-R02-B07
inventory.unitCostHint: Leave blank if this product is not priced yet.
inventory.listedHint: Unlisting keeps the row and its stock; it only hides the product from Sllr.
inventory.chooseImage: Choose an image file — JPEG, PNG, or WebP.
inventory.imageTooLarge: That image is too large. Choose one under 4 MB.
inventory.imageUnreadable: Could not read that image. Try another file.
inventory.reservedPending: Reserved {reserved} · pending {pending}. Total cannot go below what is already reserved.
inventory.custodyNote: Sllr holds {value} of this product in custody.
inventory.bulkLede: Columns are sku, total_qty, warehouse_code, and unit_cost. The last two are optional — a blank cost leaves the price alone, a dash clears it.
inventory.bulkFailed: {count, plural, one {# row did not fully go through} other {# rows did not fully go through}}. Quantity and cost are applied separately, so read each row below for what actually changed.
inventory.updateRows: Update {count, plural, one {# row} other {# rows}}
inventory.qtyAria: Total units, currently {total}. At least {reserved} is reserved.

requests.title: My requests
requests.lede: Approved quantity is what lands in Reserved for Sllr. Nothing is deducted before approval, and nothing on this page changes a quantity — dispatching happens on the daily update.
requests.empty: Nothing sent yet. Reserve a product from the catalog and it shows up here.

approvals.title: Approvals
approvals.lede: Approving moves units into Reserved for Sllr. A partial approve keeps the original request on record.
approvals.waitingCount: {count, plural, one {# request waiting.} other {# requests waiting.}}
approvals.worthAt: Worth {value}, each at the cost it was requested at.
approvals.empty: Nothing waiting. Approved requests show up in the inventory table.
approvals.exceeds: Exceeds what is left to grant by {short} — approve {available} instead
approvals.approvedToast: Approved — {count} units moved to Reserved for Sllr
approvals.leftToGrant: {available} left to grant. The request keeps its original {requested} on record.

movements.title: Movements
movements.lede: Everything that has come onto your shelf or left it. Outbound stock can never take a product below what is reserved for Sllr.
movements.empty: No movements yet. Record what arrives and what leaves and it shows up here.
movements.showingMost: · showing the most recent {limit}, narrow the dates to see further back
movements.searchPlaceholder: Search by product, SKU, code, or reference
movements.outboundLede: Stock leaving your shelf. It can never take a product below what is reserved for Sllr.
movements.wouldBreach: — that is below the {reserved} reserved for Sllr, so this will be refused.
movements.csvLede: Columns are sku, qty, kind, reference, note. Kind must be one of {kinds}.
movements.csvDispatchNote: Dispatches to Sllr are recorded on the daily update screen.
movements.recordRows: Record {count, plural, one {# row} other {# rows}}
movements.refused: {count, plural, one {# row was refused and nothing was recorded for it.} other {# rows were refused and nothing was recorded for them.}}
movements.allWentThrough: All {count} {count, plural, one {row} other {rows}} went through.

wallet.title: Wallet
wallet.ledeSllr: What each supplier is owed for stock Sllr has taken delivery of, and what has been paid.
wallet.ledeSupplier: What you are owed for stock Sllr has taken delivery of, and what has been paid.
wallet.inProgressExplain: These units have been dispatched but not yet confirmed as delivered or returned. Nothing here is payable until they are.
wallet.entriesCount: {count, plural, one {# entry} other {# entries}} · newest first
wallet.ledgerEmpty: Deliveries, returns, and payments show up here on one timeline.
wallet.overpays: — that pays more than is owed.

daily.title: Daily update
daily.lede: Everything that moved, in one paste — dispatched off the shelf, delivered, and returned. Every row shows the pool it draws from before and after, so the day can be checked before any of it is committed.
daily.noSuppliers: No suppliers to settle against yet.
daily.numbersLede: One line per SKU and kind: sku, kind, qty, occurred_on, reference. Kind is dispatched, delivered, or returned. A blank date uses the one below.
daily.doNotFit: {count, plural, one {# row does not fit.} other {# rows do not fit.}} Nothing is sent until the whole paste fits.
daily.recordRows: Record {count, plural, one {# row} other {# rows}}
daily.outstandingEmpty: Nothing approved is waiting to be dispatched.
daily.inProgressEmpty: Nothing is dispatched and waiting to be settled.
daily.resultFailed: {count, plural, one {# row did not go through.} other {# rows did not go through.}} Nothing is written unless the whole paste fits, so the rest were left alone too.
daily.resultAllOk: All {count} {count, plural, one {row} other {rows}} went through.
daily.settleLede: Columns are sku, kind, qty, occurred_on, reference. Kind is delivered or returned; a blank date uses the one below.
daily.askMore: {count, plural, one {# row asks for more than is in progress.} other {# rows ask for more than is in progress.}} Nothing is sent until every row fits.
daily.recordedRows: Recorded {count, plural, one {# row} other {# rows}}
daily.queueNote: Each product has its own queue. A row draws from that product’s oldest PO first — never the oldest PO overall.

errors.requiredFields: Name, SKU, warehouse code, and total units are all required.
errors.codeFormat: Use the line-rack-bin format, for example L03-R02-B07.
errors.wholeNumber: Enter the total units as a whole number of at least 0.
errors.costFormat: Enter the unit cost as an amount of at least 0, or leave it blank.
errors.duplicateSku: That SKU is already on your shelf. Use a different one.
errors.belowReserved: Enter a number of at least {count} — that much is already reserved.
errors.productGone: That product is no longer on the shelf.
errors.notYourShelf: That product is not on your shelf.
errors.qtyAtLeastOne: Enter a quantity of at least 1.
errors.onlySllrRequests: Only a Sllr account can request stock.
errors.onlySllrSettle: Only a Sllr account can record deliveries and returns.
errors.onlySllrDaily: Only a Sllr account can record the daily update.
errors.onlySllrPayment: Only a Sllr account can record a payment.
errors.noFreeStock: There is no free stock left on this product. Reject it, or ask the Sllr team to reduce the quantity.
errors.otherSupplier: That product belongs to another supplier.
errors.alreadyDecided: Someone already {status} this request. Refresh to see where it stands.
errors.notPending: That request is no longer pending. Refresh to see where it stands.
errors.cannotRead: Could not read those rows. Try again.
errors.nothingToRecord: There is nothing to record yet.
errors.nothingToUpdate: There is nothing to update. Paste or upload a CSV first.
errors.rowQty: {sku}: enter a quantity of at least 1.
errors.rowKindDirection: {sku}: that kind does not belong to an {direction} movement.
errors.paymentDate: Give the payment date as YYYY-MM-DD.
errors.chooseImage: Choose an image file to upload.
errors.uploadRetry: Could not upload that image. Try again.
errors.notRecordedFix: Not recorded — fix the rows that do not fit and send again
errors.notRecordedAbove: Not recorded — fix the rows above and send again
errors.nothingInProgressSku: Nothing is in progress for this SKU
errors.onlyInProgress: Only {available} units are in progress, not {wanted}
errors.stockMovementsPolicy: Stock changes are not being recorded. stock_movements has row level security on with no insert policy, and guard_total_qty is not security definer.
errors.checkInProgress: Could not check what is in progress: {message}

csvErrors.headerStock: The header needs a sku column and a total_qty column. warehouse_code and unit_cost are optional.
csvErrors.headerQty: The header needs a sku column and a qty column.
csvErrors.duplicate: {sku} appears more than once — keep one row per SKU.
csvErrors.duplicateKind: {sku} appears more than once as {kind} — combine them into one line.
csvErrors.qtyWhole: {sku} needs a whole number of at least 0, not "{value}".
csvErrors.qtyAtLeastOne: {sku} needs a whole quantity of at least 1, not "{value}".
csvErrors.costValue: {sku} has a cost of "{value}". Use a number of at least 0, blank to leave it, or - to clear it.
csvErrors.badSettlementKind: {sku}: "{value}" is not dispatched, delivered, or returned.
csvErrors.badDate: {sku}: "{value}" is not a date. Use YYYY-MM-DD.

rpc.skuNotFoundOrOther: SKU not found, or it belongs to another supplier
rpc.cannotGoBelow: Cannot go below the {reserved} units still reserved for Sllr
rpc.wouldLeave: Would leave {left} units, below the {reserved} reserved for Sllr
rpc.needsRequest: A dispatch to Sllr needs an approved request
rpc.onlyInProgress: Only {available} units are in progress for this SKU
rpc.noAnswer: The shelf did not answer. Try again.
rpc.qtyMovedAcross: {before} → {after}, across {count, plural, one {# PO} other {# POs}}

po.title: PO settlements
po.lede: A PO is one approved request for one product. Listed oldest first within each product — that is the order they settle in, not a sort.
po.queueNote: Every product has its own queue. A delivery draws from the oldest PO for that product, never the oldest PO overall.
po.empty: No POs to show yet. A reserve request becomes a PO once the supplier approves it.
po.posInQueue: {count, plural, one {# PO in this queue} other {# POs in this queue}}
po.historyEmpty: Nothing delivered or returned against this PO yet.
po.posInQueueFiltered: {shown} of {count, plural, one {# PO} other {# POs}} in this queue
